name: Jointman Infused Shooter | Bomb Pop
description:
When the big games call for the big players, call on the big shooter to get the job done. A full 1.5g of carefully infused indoor burns slow, tastes great, and makes sure you bring home the victory for whatever your game needs.

Smoke Jointman.
